mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_follow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_follow (user_id, followee_id, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{followeeId}, NOW(), #{regIp}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, followee_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_user_follow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.follow_id::TEXT AS row_id, u.handle AS followee_handle, u.nickname AS followee_nm, u.profile_file_id::TEXT AS followee_file_id, TO_CHAR(f.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_user_follow f JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = f.followee_id AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.status_cd = 'STATUS01' WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.follow_id DESC
